messages:
customer_acme: Hey team — our users see streaming responses stop mid-stream after ~45-60s. No error in the client, connection just 'hangs' then reconnects. Happening from our corp network behind a proxy.

alex_support: Sorry you're hitting that. Do you have a pcap or server-side logs we can look at? Is this only via your corporate network or everywhere?

customer_acme: Only repros from corp VPN / office network. Home/mobile is fine. No app-level error, just partial chunking then silence.

maria_cs: Adding eng-runtime and eng-platform. @charlie_eng_runtime @devon_eng_platform — customer reports silent drop/buffering during websocket streaming through corporate proxy. Likely middlebox idle timeout or proxy buffering.

charlie_eng_runtime: Thanks @maria_cs. Quick Qs: 1) Which SDK / client? 2) Are you using our streaming WS or the HTTP chunked streaming? 3) Any TLS inspection (MITM) devices?

customer_acme: 1) Web app using our frontend -> backend -> Redwood websocket proxy (we proxy from frontend to our backend then to Redwood). 2) Websocket streaming (wss). 3) Yes, corp uses a SSL-inspecting proxy (entirely possible).

alex_support: Common culprit: SSL-inspecting proxies that buffer until they see connection close or full content. They can also rewrite TLS (SNI rewrap) and disable HTTP/2 or ALPN, which changes chunking behavior.

charlie_eng_runtime: Can you reproduce a minimal repro? Two quick tests: A) From the corp network run: `websocat -t "wss://api.redwood.com/v1/stream?model=..."` and observe chunking. B) From same host run `curl -v --no-buffer https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream?model=...` to see if chunked encoding gets buffered.

customer_acme: We'll try. Also noticed our logs show FIN after ~60s from the proxy, but client shows no close. Packet capture pending.

devon_eng_platform: Also check if your proxy sets an idle timeout on upstream connections. Many proxies have default 60s idle close. If our server hasn't sent any bytes (e.g., initial model latency) the proxy will idle-close. Do you see any initial token delay?

customer_acme: Initial tokens start quickly, then after ~10 tokens there's a long silence and then nothing. Could be the proxy buffering subsequent tokens and only flushing on connection close.

alex_support: Two mitigation options for customers: 1) Add application-level heartbeats (send small ping or comment frames frequently) to keep middlebox from idling. 2) Ask proxy team to disable response buffering for the endpoint or whitelist egress to api.redwood.com so proxy passes through.

charlie_eng_runtime: We can also enable a periodic 1-byte padding frame from our side on streaming connections when we detect they come from an enterprise network. But that requires platform changes and a rollout. For immediate triage we recommend the customer tries heartbeats and pcap.

customer_acme: Can you share a small JS heartbeat snippet we can drop in quickly?

alex_support: Sure — minimal example:```js
// send ping every 20s
setInterval(() => { ws.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'heartbeat'})); }, 20_000);
```
This keeps the wire active; many proxies won't buffer then.

devon_eng_platform: For firewall/allowlist checks: ensure outbound port 443 to api.redwood.com IP ranges is allowed and DNS isn't being intercepted. Also confirm TLS version/ALPN preserved (try `openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.com:443 -alpn h2` from corp host).

customer_acme: Ran the openssl test — proxy responds with a cert that has the corp issuer (so MITM), ALPN shows http/1.1 only.

charlie_eng_runtime: That confirms TLS rewrap and ALPN downgrade. HTTP/1.1 proxied connections are more likely to be buffered. Please try heartbeat as a quick fix. We'll open an internal ticket to discuss server-side padding fallback for proxied sessions.

maria_cs: Customer asked about any config on Redwood console we can toggle for them.

charlie_eng_runtime: No per-customer toggle today. We can file a feature request to add an opt-in periodic padding/keepalive header for Dedicated/Private customers. For Hosted, we'd want to be careful about cost. For now recommend whitelisting api.redwood.com and disabling response buffering on their proxy.

customer_acme: Heartbeat helped in our quick test — streams stayed live for >5m. We'll request whitelist from security team.

alex_support: Great. Can you also share pcap when you have it? We'd like to confirm whether the proxy buffers and then TCP FINs or if it rewrites content.

customer_acme: Will send pcap and proxy config snippet once security approves. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy_bot: Deploy succeeded: streaming-heartbeat-experiments v1.2 -> prod at 2026-02-14T12:34:00Z

devon_eng_platform: Noted — created INF-3421 to track potential server-side keepalive padding. Charlie assigned.

charlie_eng_runtime: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: 1) @customer_acme send pcap + proxy cfg, 2) @alex_support confirm when whitelist is in place, 3) engineering to evaluate INF-3421 impact and rollout plan.

customer_acme: Will do. Appreciate the quick triage.
